title: Spike v8 surface classification — formspec-cloud Claude Design mockup corpus
routeAuthority: surfaces/route-map.html (61 product routes; the corpus draws 36 of them)
method: Every corpus file is classified into one pattern family. One exemplar per family was translated into AppGraph artifacts through Wireframes-MCP; the rest are covered at classification level only.

families.what: Filtered, sorted, paginated collection of workspace artifacts with row state and row actions.
families.substrateStrain: No list slot, no filter-bar slot, no data source, no bulk-action subject, no empty/loading state, no user-scoped view state.

families.what: Data-bound overview: KPI tiles with deltas, distribution charts, activity feed, posture panel.
families.substrateStrain: No stat-tile, no visualization, no event-feed, no runtime status region.

families.what: One subject artifact, identity header, tab sub-navigation, related-collection panels.
families.substrateStrain: No sub-route/tab IA, no typed route parameter, embed-route semantics undefined across bundles.

families.what: Chrome wrapping a full-bleed third-party canvas, plus outline and inspector panes and a lint footer.
families.substrateStrain: No Registry admission path for first-party modules, no tree slot, no cross-slot selection channel.

families.what: Ordered multi-step flow with progress, gating, irreversibility, and resumption.
families.substrateStrain: No step-sequence contract; definition-form fits the step forms but no verb mints the Definition.

families.what: Section-navigated read-mostly panels with occasional high-consequence actions.
families.substrateStrain: No read-only data-view primitive; no action targets outside form submission.

families.what: Registry of integration objects plus delivery/usage history with replay-class actions and secrets.
families.substrateStrain: No operational-action vocabulary; no sensitivity annotation for secrets.

families.what: Public, procurement-facing content: claims, matrices, subprocessor lists, dated evidence.
families.substrateStrain: No matrix/table static-content kind; compliance facts are authored strings with no freshness contract.

families.what: Anonymous tool taking user-supplied bytes, computing locally, rendering a typed result.
families.substrateStrain: No client-executed action target; no artifact-input slot outside a Definition.

families.what: Single high-consequence commitment with immutable chrome, evidence capture, and co-actor state.
families.substrateStrain: No signature-capture slot; no identity-assurance precondition; no theme-authority assertion.

families.what: Two versions of one artifact, aligned, with a semantic change list and a source-level diff.
families.substrateStrain: No compare slot; no artifact-lineage primitive carrying pin/hash/retirement semantics.

families.what: Durable evidence document that must render without JavaScript and without tenant theming.
families.substrateStrain: Same read-only-display and theme-authority gaps as settings and ceremony; no-JS render is not assertable.

families.what: The substrate's design center: a respondent completing a Definition-backed form.
families.substrateStrain: None recorded — this is what the closed substrate was sized for.

families.what: Cross-cutting non-product surfaces: auth gate, system status, email kit, placeholder, navigation map.
families.substrateStrain: Out-of-band rendering targets (email), runtime health state, and design-system placeholders sit outside the app-graph model entirely.
